SELECT f.channel_code, f.channel_id, (s.store_id>=900) AS pseudo, s.store_id>=900 AND s.store_id IS NOT NULL AS x, f.staff_purchase_flag,
 count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_lines, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
 sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.sale_date) mind, max(f.sale_date) maxd, min(f.net_amount) minnet, sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos,
 count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, min(s.store_id) mins, max(s.store_id) maxs
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,5

UNION ALL
SELECT 'store', store_key::VARCHAR, store_id::VARCHAR, store_name, format, open_date::VARCHAR, close_date::VARCHAR || ' ' || valid_from::VARCHAR || ' ' || valid_to::VARCHAR FROM dim_store WHERE store_id>=900
UNION ALL

WITH r AS (
 SELECT sum(receipts) receipts, sum(units_sold) units, sum(net_sales_before_returns) gross_sales, sum(returns_net) rets, sum(net_sales) net_sales, count(DISTINCT store_id) stores, max(store_id) maxstore
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'),
f AS (
 SELECT f.staff_purchase_flag sp, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, sum(f.quantity) units, sum(f.net_amount) net
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'rpt' src, receipts::VARCHAR a, units::VARCHAR b, gross_sales::VARCHAR c, rets::VARCHAR d, net_sales::VARCHAR e, stores::VARCHAR || '/' || maxstore::VARCHAR g FROM r
UNION ALL SELECT 'fact sp=' || sp::VARCHAR, receipts::VARCHAR, units::VARCHAR, net::VARCHAR, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM f

SELECT f.channel_id, w.status, w.fulfilment_type, count(*) line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, sum(f.net_amount) net,
 sum(CASE WHEN w.web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_order, min(f.sale_date) mind, max(f.sale_date) maxd,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(w.order_ts_utc AS DATE) <> f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) datediff, max(w.line_count) maxlc
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND f.channel_id IN (2,3)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH w AS (SELECT f.*, s.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND s.store_id<>999),
rc AS (SELECT receipt_id, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT line_no) dl, count(DISTINCT sale_date) dd, count(DISTINCT store_key) ds, count(DISTINCT channel_id) dc, sum(net_amount) tot, sum(quantity) q FROM w GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'receipts' k, count(*)::VARCHAR a, sum(CASE WHEN n<>dl THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::VARCHAR b, sum(CASE WHEN dd>1 OR ds>1 OR dc>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::VARCHAR c, max(tot)::VARCHAR d, avg(tot)::VARCHAR e, sum(CASE WHEN tot<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::VARCHAR g FROM rc
UNION ALL SELECT 'load_ts', date_trunc('month', etl_loaded_at)::VARCHAR, count(*)::VARCHAR, min(etl_loaded_at)::VARCHAR, max(etl_loaded_at)::VARCHAR, NULL, NULL FROM w GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL SELECT 'qty', min(quantity)::VARCHAR, max(quantity)::VARCHAR, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::VARCHAR, sum(CASE WHEN abs(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)-gross_amount)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::VARCHAR, sum(CASE WHEN member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::VARCHAR, NULL FROM w
UNION ALL SELECT 'in_stg', count(*)::VARCHAR, NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_not_in_fact', count(*)::VARCHAR, NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM stg_sales_line_load t WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=t.sales_line_id)

WITH f AS (SELECT f.sale_date d, s.store_id sid, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc, sum(f.net_amount) net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND s.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT business_date d, store_id sid, receipts rc, net_sales_before_returns net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02')
SELECT coalesce(f.d,r.d) d, coalesce(f.sid,r.sid) sid, f.rc frc, r.rc rrc, f.net fnet, r.net rnet
FROM f FULL JOIN r ON f.d=r.d AND f.sid=r.sid
WHERE f.rc IS DISTINCT FROM r.rc OR f.net IS DISTINCT FROM r.net
ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 60

WITH cal AS (
  SELECT min(period_start_date) p_start, max(period_end_date) p_end
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
sales AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  CROSS JOIN cal
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN cal.p_start AND cal.p_end
    AND s.store_id <> 999),
rets AS (
  SELECT sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, sum(r.refund_gross) refund_gross
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  CROSS JOIN cal
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN cal.p_start AND cal.p_end AND s.store_id <> 999),
tot AS (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT receipt_id) receipts, sum(net_amount) net, sum(gross_amount) gross,
    count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN receipt_id END) receipts_nostaff,
    sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount END) net_nostaff
  FROM sales)
SELECT tot.receipts, round(tot.net,2) net, round(tot.net/tot.receipts,2) atv_net,
  round(tot.gross/tot.receipts,2) atv_gross, round((tot.net-rets.refund_net)/tot.receipts,2) atv_net_after_returns,
  round(tot.net_nostaff/tot.receipts_nostaff,2) atv_net_nostaff, rets.refund_net
FROM tot, rets
